questions.question: A. A mid-sized manufacturing company is aiming to improve cost control and profitability. The management is exploring the introduction of a cost accounting system to support better financial decision -making.As a cost accountant, prepare a writeup for management that explains the objectives of cost accounting, describes its key functions, and highlights the advantages of implementing cost accounting in their operational context.(K, CO1) OR B. The following data has been extracted from the books of ABC Manufacturing Company Ltd. for the year ended 31st December 2024: Particulars 01-01-2024 (₹) 31-12-2024 (₹) Stock of Raw Materials 30,000 25,000 Stock of Work-in-Progress 12,000 15,000 Stock of Finished Goods 60,000 55,000 Other Information: • Purchases of Raw Materials: ₹4,50,000 • Direct Wages: ₹2,30,000 • Factory Overhead: ₹92,000 • Administration Overhead: ₹30,000 • Selling & Distribution Overhead: ₹20,000 • Sales Revenue: ₹9,00,000 You are required to prepare a Cost Sheet for the year ended 31st December 2024, showing the Prime Cost, Factory Cost, Cost of Production, Cost of Goods Sold, Cost of Sales, and Profit.(A, CO1)
questions.solution_html:
Comprehensive Evaluation Rubric (Essay / Long Problem):
• Introduction & Conceptual Foundation (2 Marks): Comprehensive overview, definitions, contextual scope, and historical/theoretical relevance.
• Detailed Structural Analysis & Derivations (5 Marks): Deep exploration covering all relevant dimensions, mathematical proofs, architectural diagrams, or comparative taxonomies.
• Practical Applications & Critical Evaluation (2 Marks): Real-world applications, computational complexity, empirical validation, or critical critique.
• Conclusion & Summary (1 Mark): Concise synthesis connecting theoretical outcomes with course objectives.
Valuation Guidance: Full marks are awarded for clear structural organization, labeled diagrams/formulations where applicable, and exhaustive coverage of all sub-parts.
